definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used when you are referring to a particular thing or person that has already been mentioned or is already known about 
1a. used when it is obvious which one you are referring to because there is only one 
1b. used when you are referring to familiar things that people deal with regularly 
2. used before a singular noun when making a general statement about people or things of a particular type 
3. used when referring to a part of a particular thing
examples: [{"en": "Have you locked the door?", "cn": "你锁门了吗？"}, {"en": "The sun was hidden behind a cloud.", "cn": "太阳隐藏在云层后面。"}, {"en": "I looked up at the ceiling.", "cn": "我抬头看着天花板。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. connected with or part of someone/​something used for saying who or what has a particular feature, aspect, or quality 
2. saying which specific thing 
2a. used for saying which specific thing belonging to a more general type you are referring to 
2b. used for giving a specific age, amount, value etc 
3. saying who or what does something
examples: [{"en": "We were impressed by the size of the building.", "cn": "这座建筑的规模给我们留下了深刻的印象。"}, {"en": "I had a feeling of duty towards him.", "cn": "我对他有一种责任感。"}, {"en": "She met Charles at the age of 20.", "cn": "她20岁时认识了查尔斯。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used between words, phrases etc in order to connect them together 
2. used for showing that one thing happens after another 
3. used for showing what your intention or purpose is after verbs such as ‘go’, ‘come’, ‘try’, or ‘wait’ 
4. used for showing that one thing causes another 
5. used for connecting words that are repeated for emphasis
examples: [{"en": "the lakes and mountains of Scotland", "cn": "苏格兰的湖泊和山脉"}, {"en": "He switched off the television and went to bed.", "cn": "他关掉电视，上床睡觉了。"}, {"en": "I’ll try and find out where we can buy tickets.", "cn": "我会尝试找出在哪里可以买到票。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used as part of an infinitive 
1a. used for forming an infinitive that is the subject, object, or complement of a verb, or is the complement of an adjective, noun, or pronoun 
1b. used for showing the purpose of an action 
1c. used instead of an infinitive in order to avoid repeating the verb 
2. going somewhere
examples: [{"en": "I hope to see you next week.", "cn": "我希望下周见到你。"}, {"en": "Nobody came to help me.", "cn": "没有人来帮助我。"}, {"en": "You don’t need to come if you don’t want to.", "cn": "如果您不想来，则无需来。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for showing where someone or something is 
1a. inside a container, room, building, vehicle etc 
1b. within an area, city, or country 
1c. at home, or at your office 
1d. within an object, space, or substance
examples: [{"en": "He had left his passport in his coat pocket.", "cn": "他把护照留在外套口袋里了。"}, {"en": "The books are printed in Hong Kong.", "cn": "这些书在香港印刷。"}, {"en": "Most evenings we stay in and watch television.", "cn": "大多数晚上我们都呆在家里看电视。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. intended to help or benefit someone/​something 
1a. used for saying who or what is intended to receive something or get the benefit of it 
1b. used for saying that someone does something so that someone else does not have to do it 
1c. in order to protect someone or something 
2. used for stating a purpose used for stating the purpose of an object or action
examples: [{"en": "I’ve brought a cup of tea for you.", "cn": "我给你端了一杯茶。"}, {"en": "Betty will take care of things for us while we’re away.", "cn": "我们不在的时候，贝蒂会帮我们处理事情。"}, {"en": "We are here today to honour those who died for their country.", "cn": "今天我们在这里向那些为国捐躯的人们致敬。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. touching a surface or an object 
1a. touching and supported by the top surface of something 
1b. onto a surface 
1c. touching, sticking to, or hanging from a surface or object 
2. at a particular time used for saying the day or date when something happens
examples: [{"en": "Chad was asleep on the floor in a heap of blankets.", "cn": "查德睡在地板上的一堆毯子里。"}, {"en": "Alanis dropped her books on the desk.", "cn": "艾拉妮丝把书扔到了桌子上。"}, {"en": "There were several interesting posters on the wall.", "cn": "墙上贴着几张有趣的海报。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. [ plural those UK [ðəʊz] US [ðoʊz] ] the one that is known about 
1a. used when you are referring to someone or something that has already been mentioned 
1b. spoken used for referring to someone or something that the person you are speaking to already knows about 
2. [ plural those UK [ðəʊz] US [ðoʊz] ] the one that you are looking at spoken 
2a. used for referring to someone or something that is not very near to you but that you can see or point at
examples: [{"en": "I know there’s a problem, but I haven’t got time to worry about that now.", "cn": "我知道有问题，但我现在没时间担心。"}, {"en": "The engine’s started making that noise again.", "cn": "发动机又开始发出那种噪音。"}, {"en": "That’s Jerry’s car, over there.", "cn": "那边那是杰瑞的车。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for saying who or what does something 
1a. used, especially with passive verbs, for showing who does something or what causes something 
1b. used for saying who wrote a book or a piece of music, who painted a picture etc 
2. used for saying how something is done 
2a. using a particular method to achieve something
examples: [{"en": "Injured refugees were treated by a Red Cross doctor.", "cn": "红十字会医生对受伤的难民进行了治疗。"}, {"en": "a novel by Graham Greene", "cn": "格雷厄姆·格林的小说"}, {"en": "Reading is taught by traditional methods here.", "cn": "这里采用传统方法教授阅读。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. [ plural these UK [ðiːz] US [ðiz] ] the one that is known used when you are referring to a particular person, thing, fact etc that has just been mentioned, or when it is obvious which one you are referring to 
2. what you are going to say mainly spoken used for referring to the particular thing that you are going to talk about 
3. [ plural these UK [ðiːz] US [ðiz] ] the one that is here 
3a. used for referring to something that you are wearing, holding, or showing 
3b. used for referring to the place that you are in
examples: [{"en": "Sometimes there’s flooding, and this is why no one wants to live here.", "cn": "有时会发生洪水，这就是为什么没有人愿意住在这里。"}, {"en": "Now, this is what I want you to do, so listen carefully.", "cn": "现在，这就是我要你做的，所以请仔细听。"}, {"en": "I’ve brought this book to show you.", "cn": "我带来这本书是为了给你看。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. together if one person or thing is with another or does something with them, they are together or they do it together 
2. having or holding something 
2a. used for saying what possessions, qualities, or features someone or something has 
2b. used for saying what someone is holding or carrying 
3. by means of something used for saying what is used for doing something
examples: [{"en": "Hannah lives with her parents.", "cn": "汉娜和她的父母住在一起。"}, {"en": "a girl with red hair", "cn": "一个红头发的女孩"}, {"en": "We saw Moore coming back with a drink in his hand.", "cn": "我们看到摩尔手里拿着一杯饮料回来了。"}]

definition: [麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for referring to the person or people that you are talking or writing to \n2. used for referring to people in general
examples: [{"en": "Do you like oranges?", "cn": "你喜欢橙子吗？"}, {"en": "He wasn’t very good-looking, but you could tell he thought he was.", "cn": "他长得不太好看，但你看得出来他是这么想的。"}, {"en": "What do you want?", "cn": "你想要什么？"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. referring to something that has been mentioned 
1a. used for referring to a thing, situation, place, animal etc when it has already been mentioned or when it is obvious which one you are referring to 
1b. used for referring to a baby or very young child when it has already been mentioned, or when it is obvious which one you are referring to 
2. used as the subject object of a sentence 
2a. used instead of the subject of a sentence, when the real subject is a phrase or clause at the end of the sentence
examples: [{"en": "I can’t find my ticket. I think I must have lost it.", "cn": "我找不到我的票。我想我一定是失去了它。"}, {"en": "Is it a boy or a girl?", "cn": "是男孩还是女孩？"}, {"en": "It’s nice to be home again.", "cn": "很高兴再次回家。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for making negatives 
1a. used for making a sentence, expression, or word negative 
1b. used instead of repeating something in the negative or not
2. used for showing the opposite used for showing that you mean the opposite of the word or phrase that follows 
3. used for asking questions spoken
examples: [{"en": "He would not listen to anything she said.", "cn": "她说什么他都不会听。"}, {"en": "Are you coming with me or not?", "cn": "你跟我一起去还是不跟我一起去？"}, {"en": "It’s not much fun living with a drug addict.", "cn": "和吸毒者一起生活可不是什么有趣的事。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for showing possibilities or choices used for connecting possibilities or choices. In a list, ‘or’ is usually used only before the last possibility or choice 
2. and not used for including someone or something else in a negative statement 
3. used when amounts or numbers are not exact used between two similar numbers for showing that you do not know what the exact number is one or two/​two or three/​three or four etc
4. used in warnings, threats, or advice used for saying what will happen if someone does not do something 
5. used when correcting or explaining used for introducing a comment that corrects or adds more information to what you have just said
examples: [{"en": "Which colour do you want – red, green, yellow, or blue?", "cn": "您想要哪种颜色——红色、绿色、黄色还是蓝色？"}, {"en": "She’s had nothing to eat or drink all day.", "cn": "她一整天没吃没喝。"}, {"en": "I can photocopy your notes. It’ll only take a minute or two.", "cn": "我可以复印你的笔记。只需要一两分钟。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used in progressive verb tenses [auxiliary verb] used for forming the progressive tenses of verbs, that are used for showing actions that are in progress at a particular point in time 
2. used in passive verb forms [auxiliary verb] used for forming the passive form of verbs 
3. used in descriptions [linking verb] used for giving information about someone or something, by giving their name, job, position etc, describing them, or saying where they are 
4. used for talking about behaviour [linking verb] used for saying how someone behaves, or for telling them how to behave 
5. existence [intransitive] formal to exist
examples: [{"en": "Is everyone listening?", "cn": "每个人都在听吗？"}, {"en": "Her husband was killed in a car accident.", "cn": "她的丈夫在一场车祸中丧生。"}, {"en": "Calvin Schultz is our Marketing Director.", "cn": "卡尔文·舒尔茨是我们的营销总监。"}]

definition: [麦克米伦高阶] 1. [ singular

[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. given, sent, or provided by someone used for stating who gives or sends you something or provides you with something 
2. used for stating someone’s/​something’s origin 
2a. used for stating the place where someone lives or used to live, or their general situation in life 
2b. used for stating the place where something was made 
2c. used for stating what something was originally a part of
examples: [{"en": "You’ll have to borrow the money from someone else.", "cn": "你必须向别人借钱。"}, {"en": "I’m originally from Northern Ireland.", "cn": "我来自北爱尔兰。"}, {"en": "red wine from California", "cn": "来自加州的红酒"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for stating where someone or something is 
1a. in a particular place 
1b. used for saying where you stop on a journey 
1c. sitting or standing close to something, especially in order to do something 
1d. in a particular part of a process, activity, programme, or book
examples: [{"en": "There’s a telephone box at the crossroads.", "cn": "十字路口有一个电话亭。"}, {"en": "Does this train stop at Newport?", "cn": "这趟火车在纽波特停靠吗？"}, {"en": "Lambert was seated at the piano.", "cn": "兰伯特坐在钢琴前。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for showing comparison 
1a. used for comparing one person, thing, or situation with another as...as
1b. used in particular expressions for emphasizing a quality in someone or something 
2. used for referring to what is known spoken used for mentioning that something is already known or has already been talked about 
3. in the same way used for saying that something happens or is done in the same way
examples: [{"en": "Simon isn’t as tall as his brother.", "cn": "西蒙没有他哥哥那么高。"}, {"en": "Her skin was white as snow.", "cn": "她的皮肤白如雪。"}, {"en": "As I was saying, we expect next year to be a good year.", "cn": "正如我所说，我们预计明年将是美好的一年。"}]

definition: [麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for showing that something belongs to or is connected with the person or people you are talking or writing to \n2. used for showing that something belongs to or is connected with people in general \n3. informal used for showing that something is a typical or normal example of its type
examples: [{"en": "You never really talk to your parents, do you?", "cn": "你从来没有真正和你的父母说过话，是吗？"}, {"en": "The centre can provide help when you’ve lost your job.", "cn": "当您失业时，该中心可以提供帮助。"}, {"en": "The National Television Awards is your typical glitzy event.", "cn": "国家电视奖是典型的炫目盛事。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. the whole of something 
1a. the whole of an amount or every part of something 
1b. the whole of a period of time 
1c. the whole of a group 
1d. the whole of a situation or problem
examples: [{"en": "There’s no cake left. They’ve eaten it all.", "cn": "蛋糕已经没有了。他们都吃完了。"}, {"en": "Sally had spent all her life working for others.", "cn": "莎莉一生都在为别人工作。"}, {"en": "entertainment for all the family", "cn": "适合全家人的娱乐活动"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for forming perfect tenses [auxiliary verb] never progressive 
1a. used for forming the perfect tenses of verbs. The perfect tenses are used for talking about what happened or began before now or another point in time 
1b. had someone/​something done something... used for saying that something would have happened if the situation had been different 
2. have variant have got variant used for describing someone/​something [transitive] never progressive 
2a. used for saying what the physical features of someone or something are
examples: [{"en": "Has anybody seen Dave this afternoon?", "cn": "今天下午有人见过戴夫吗？"}, {"en": "Had I realized what you were intending to do, I would have stopped you.", "cn": "如果我意识到你想做什么，我就会阻止你。"}, {"en": "Dr Morel had dark piercing eyes.", "cn": "莫雷尔医生有一双深邃而锐利的眼睛。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. recently created, built, invented, or planned 
1a. recently developed, or starting to develop 
1b. recently made and never used by anyone before 
1c. recently bought or supplied to someone 
1d. recently obtained
examples: [{"en": "They are going to build a new office block here.", "cn": "他们要在这里建造一座新的办公楼。"}, {"en": "I was enthusiastic and full of new ideas.", "cn": "我充满热情，充满新想法。"}, {"en": "Is this camera new?", "cn": "这台相机是新的吗？"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. having more of a particular quality used for saying that a particular quality is stronger in one person or thing than in another, stronger than it was before, or stronger than you expected or hoped 
2. a larger amount or number an amount or number that is larger than another, larger than it was before, or larger than you expected 
3. happening more 
3a. happening or doing something a greater number of times, or for longer periods 
3b. to a greater degree more...than
examples: [{"en": "Scotland has become more prosperous in recent years.", "cn": "近年来，苏格兰变得更加繁荣。"}, {"en": "No matter what her brother gets, she always wants more.", "cn": "无论她哥哥得到什么，她总是想要更多。"}, {"en": "You should get out more and meet other people.", "cn": "你应该多出去走走，认识其他人。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for referring to yourself and one or more other people when you are the person speaking or writing 
2. used for including yourself and the person you are speaking to in what you are saying or writing 
3. used for referring to people in general 
4. spoken sometimes used instead of ‘you’, especially when a doctor or nurse is speaking to someone who is ill or when a teacher is speaking to children
examples: [{"en": "We moved here soon after we were married.", "cn": "我们结婚后不久就搬到了这里。"}, {"en": "Where shall we meet?", "cn": "我们在哪里见面？"}, {"en": "We live in a competitive world.", "cn": "我们生活在一个竞争激烈的世界。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for talking about future actions or events 
1a. used for saying what you expect to happen in the future 
1b. used for saying what is planned or arranged for a future occasion 
2. used for showing that you are fairly certain used for showing that you are fairly certain that something is true 
3. to be willing used for saying that you are willing to do something or that you intend to do it
examples: [{"en": "Let’s finish the job now – it won’t take long.", "cn": "我们现在就完成这项工作吧——不会花很长时间的。"}, {"en": "There will be a short ceremony at the war memorial.", "cn": "战争纪念馆将举行一个简短的仪式。"}, {"en": "Most of you will know about the problems we’ve been having.", "cn": "你们中的大多数人都会知道我们一直遇到的问题。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. [countable/uncountable] the place where you live 
1a. [uncountable] the place where your parents live and where you grew up at home
1b. [uncountable] the country or city where you live make something your home
1c. only before noun relating to your home rather than your work 
1d. only before noun done, made, or experienced at home
examples: [{"en": "We go to a school close to our home.", "cn": "我们去离家很近的一所学校。"}, {"en": "He is 43 and still living at home.", "cn": "他43岁了，仍然住在家里。"}, {"en": "We decided to make Jamaica our home.", "cn": "我们决定把牙买加作为我们的家。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. have the ability or means to do something 
1a. to have the necessary ability, knowledge, money, or equipment to do something 
1b. used for saying that you see, hear, feel, taste, smell, understand, or remember something 
2. used for saying what is possible 
2a. used for saying whether the situation makes it possible for you to do something at a particular time
examples: [{"en": "‘Can you swim?’ ‘No I can’t.’", "cn": "“你会游泳吗？”“不，我不会。”"}, {"en": "Paul could hear someone calling his name.", "cn": "保罗听到有人喊他的名字。"}, {"en": "I’m sorry, Dr Brown can’t speak to you now – she’s got someone with her.", "cn": "抱歉，布朗医生现在不能和你说话——她有人陪着她。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. concerning a particular subject 
1a. used for stating who or what you are discussing, considering, describing, forgetting etc 
1b. used for stating who or what your feelings and attitudes are directed towards 
1c. spoken used for introducing a subject that you want to discuss 
2. not exactly a particular amount or number
examples: [{"en": "Think about what I’ve told you.", "cn": "想想我告诉你的话。"}, {"en": "I’m worried about Dad.", "cn": "我很担心爸爸。"}, {"en": "About that money I owe you – I can pay you back next week.", "cn": "关于我欠你的钱——我可以下周还给你。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. in a possible or imagined situation 
1a. used for introducing a situation that may happen or may be real, especially when talking about its results 
1b. used for introducing a situation or condition that must exist before something else happens 
1c. used for introducing a situation that does not exist now and is unlikely or impossible, especially when talking about its imaginary results 
1d. used for introducing a situation that might have existed in the past but did not exist, especially when talking about what its results might have been
examples: [{"en": "If we miss the last bus, we’ll have to walk home.", "cn": "如果我们错过了末班车，我们就得步行回家。"}, {"en": "Okay I’ll come with you if you’ll promise not to go too fast.", "cn": "好吧，如果你保证不走得太快，我就跟你一起去。"}, {"en": "If Luke paid more attention in class, he would achieve better results.", "cn": "如果卢克在课堂上更加专心的话，他会取得更好的成绩。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. one side of a sheet of paper in a book, newspaper, or magazine 
1a. a sheet of paper in a book, newspaper, or magazine 
1b. a piece of paper 
2. computing the writing or pictures on a computer screen that you can see at one time, for example as part of a website 
2a. computing the writing or pictures on a computer screen that you can print on one side of a piece of paper Thesaurus: on the computer screen hyponym computer programs and systems hyponym
examples: [{"en": "the poem on page 125", "cn": "第125页的诗"}, {"en": "I tore a page out of my diary and wrote my phone number on it.", "cn": "我从日记中撕下一页，在上面写下了我的电话号码。"}, {"en": "He was staring miserably at the blank page in his typewriter.", "cn": "他痛苦地盯着打字机上的空白页。"}]

definition: [麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for showing that something belongs to or is connected with you when you are the person speaking or writing \n2. used when speaking to someone that you love or that you know well \n3. used in some expressions of surprise, shock, or anger
examples: [{"en": "I shut my eyes.", "cn": "我闭上眼睛。"}, {"en": "‘Let’s go for a walk, my dear,’ Alice said.", "cn": "“我们去散步吧，亲爱的，”爱丽丝说。"}, {"en": "My! Just look at all those lovely cakes!", "cn": "我的！看看那些可爱的蛋糕吧！"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. an attempt to find something 
1a. an attempt to find an answer or information search for
2. the process of examining official documents to find information search of
2a. the process of using a computer to find information, especially on the Internet do a search
1. [intransitive/transitive] to try to find something or someone by looking carefully
examples: [{"en": "Despite a thorough search, they found no drugs on him.", "cn": "尽管进行了彻底搜查，他们在他身上没有发现毒品。"}, {"en": "The committee is involved in a search for solutions to key international problems.", "cn": "该委员会致力于寻找关键国际问题的解决方案。"}, {"en": "A search of the parish records provided useful biographical information.", "cn": "对教区记录的搜索提供了有用的传记信息。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. something that is free does not cost anything 
2. not a prisoner or a slave 
3. not held, tied, or fixed to somewhere 
4. not limited or controlled by rules 
4a. allowed to decide for yourself what you do, say, or think, especially without being controlled by someone in authority
examples: [{"en": "All talks start at 2.30 pm and admission is free.", "cn": "所有讲座均于下午 2.30 开始，免费入场。"}, {"en": "He will soon be a free man again.", "cn": "他很快就会再次成为自由人。"}, {"en": "Hand me the free end of the rope.", "cn": "把绳子的自由端递给我。"}]

definition:
[麦克米伦红星 ★★★] 1. used for introducing a different idea used for joining two ideas or statements when the second one is different from the first one, or seems surprising after the first one 
1a. used after a negative for introducing what is true instead 
2. used for changing the subject mainly spoken used when you are saying that you should not talk any more about a subject that you have just mentioned 
3. used in polite questions, requests, and statements spoken used after expressions such as ‘I’m sorry’ and ‘excuse me’ to introduce a polite question, request, or statement 
4. except used especially after words such as ‘nothing’, ‘everyone’, or ‘anything’ to mean ‘except’
